pairs.locus: Boym, Cafraria (1644), para. 'Omnes Cafres sunt nigri coloris'
pairs.question: Tu vero quoties homines comedisti?
pairs.answer: Bis, semel caput unius, altera vice pedes alterius.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange. The narrator (author) asks the Cafer how many times he has eaten men; the Cafer answers in direct speech. Dropped the framing speech tag 'inquit' interleaved in the reply ('"Bis", inquit, "semel caput unius..."'). Question kept verbatim; answer is the contiguous utterance with internal 'inquit' removed. Stops at the full stop ending the reply.

pairs.locus: Boym, Cafraria (1644), para. 'Quando Cafres salutant aliquem'
pairs.question: Quid melius, panisne, oryza an milium?
pairs.answer: Panis implet ventrem et transit, similiter oryza; solum milium implet et manet.
pairs.derivation: Direct-speech exchange introduced by the framing participle 'Quaesiti' (dropped as narration of the asking) and the speech verb 'respondent' (dropped). The verbatim interrogative 'quid melius, panisne, oryza an milium' is the question; the quoted reply is the answer, kept verbatim and contiguous. First-word capitalization and terminal punctuation normalized; the parenthetical aside that follows the quotation ('carnem tamen libenter comedunt...') is outside the answer and omitted.
